comments.note: src/index.ts still has two commented-out builder exports (builders/frontmatter.js, builders/persona-builder.js) from WP-006 not yet implemented. These are safe placeholders but could cause confusion for contributors scanning the barrel export. No action needed in this WP.

The validateFileName() multi-rule design produces one error per violated rule (e.g. both 'uppercase' and 'kebab-case' rules fire for 'MyPersona.md'). This is intentional — gives callers maximum diagnostic information — but callers should be aware they may receive 2+ errors for a single bad filename.

The FilenameRule interface in filename-validator.ts is unexported (module-private). If a future WP needs to register custom filename rules, consider exporting the interface from src/validators/index.ts.

comments.note: Edge case: trailing-slash path (e.g. '/path/to/') produces an empty basename string which is correctly flagged as a kebab-case violation. Benign defensive behavior — callers should always pass a filename or a path with a non-empty basename segment.

Empty-string marker in validateStrictMarkers() is treated as always-present (JS: ''.includes('') === true). This is correct per the JS spec and consistent with the inclusion-check design. Callers should never pass empty-string markers, but the behavior is safe.
No filename length limit is enforced by validateFileName(). A 300-character all-lowercase kebab filename passes without error. Not a WP requirement, but worth noting for future hardening.
